'''Dexter Thorgrim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who worked as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Thorgrim was the [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] of the pirate ship [[Retribution (Discril-class)|''Retribution'']] and he was personally responsible for selecting candidates to become new crew members of the ship.

==Equipment==
Thorgrim carried with him a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shiv]].
